# greedy backward elimination of small terms
idx=list(range(X.shape[1]))
while len(idx)>3:
    cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X[:,idx],dP_dt,rcond=None)
    rr=dP_dt-X[:,idx]@cc
    e=np.mean(rr**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    # find removal with smallest increase
    best=None
    for j in range(len(idx)):
        sub=idx[:j]+idx[j+1:]
        c2,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X[:,sub],dP_dt,rcond=None)
        e2=np.mean((dP_dt-X[:,sub]@c2)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
        if best is None or e2<best[0]: best=(e2,j)
    if best[0]>1e-6: break
    idx.pop(best[1])
